product_metadata.title: BrizLabs 2 Pack Shamrock String Lights, 17.06ft 50 LED Green Lucky Clover Light, Battery Powered Silver Wire Lights for St.Patrick's Day Irish Day Party Home Decor
features: 【Green Shamrock String Lights】17.06ft long silver wire shamrock string lights with 50pcs green LED(2 pack total 34.12ft, 100 LED), the beautiful shamrock string lights with a green warm glow, perfect match the green for St.Patrick's Day theme, great for St.Patrick's Day Irish Day and all kinds of festivities celebration, the best gift for family and friends.

【Lucky St.Patrick's Day String Lights】Our lucky St.Patrick's Day lights is different from the traditional ordinary string light, it adopts the shape of lucky four-leaf clover pattern and the leaves are heart-shaped. Looking beautiful when lit or not lit up, emitting green light bring you creative atmosphere for St.Patrick's Day, which perfectly interprets the theme of St.Patrick's Day.

【Built-in Timer Function】The battery case is designed with timer function, just turn on the timer on the battery box to set a timer, once timer set, the shamrock string lights will be automatically on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours per day, easy to operate and prolonged battery life.

【Battery Operated Design】Our st.patrick's day green shamrock lights designed with 3*AA battery operated and low voltage, then you can switch between "on/off /timer" to open and close the lights, very easy and safe to operate, you can place these shamrock lights anywhere indoor or outdoor decoration.

【Multiple Decorative Use】Made of soft silver wire, It is easy to decorate on plants or other objects, you can decorate your St.Patrick's Day, birthday party, wedding, home, bedroom, garden, patio, porch, fence, lawn, yards, halls, church decoration or other places you want.[ Perfect Customer Service: If you have any questions about st.patrick's day shamrock string lights, please don't hesitate to contact us at any time, and we will reply in 24 hours and offer you a satisfied solution.]
